metadata.name: UpdateMerchantAccountParameter
metadata.description: This API is Used to update the Merchant Account Parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantNumber not Inputted in API Request

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:205136549 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantNumber not Inputted in API Request

request_fields.name: BillingCycle
request_fields.description: The Billing Cycle Assigned for the Merchant Valid Values: refer the Appendix section 5.13 Billing Cycle

request_fields.name: StatementPrintingSequence
request_fields.description: Indicates in what Sequence/order the Statement must be Printed Valid Values: '0' = Account Number Order and '1' = ZIP Code Order Format: X Example: 0 Condition: If kept Blank Default Value will be considered as '0' = Account Number Order

request_fields.name: StatementForm
request_fields.description: Indicates the Statement printed will be as a Form or Custom Made Valid Values: '0' = Form and '1' = Custom Format: X Example: 0 Condition: If kept Blank Default Value will be considered as '0' = Form

request_fields.name: CreditLimitOTBDisplay
request_fields.description: Determines if the Credit Limit and OTB will be Displayed on Merchant Statement or Not. Valid Values: 0-Display on Statement 1-Do not display on Statement Format: X Example: 0 Condition: If kept Blank Default Value will be considered as '0' = Display on Statement

request_fields.name: DefaultCreditLimit
request_fields.description: Default Credit Limit Assigned for the Merchant Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 1000.00

request_fields.name: MSRPolicyIdentifier
request_fields.description: Credit Policy on the Merchant Valid Values: '1' = Grandfathered and '2' = Standard Format: X Example: 0 Condition: If kept Blank Default Value will be considered as '1' = Grandfathered

request_fields.name: MSRLineAssignmentPolicy
request_fields.description: Line Assignment Policy on the Merchant Valid Values: '1' = Grandfathered and '2' = Standard Format: X Example: 0

request_fields.name: ProductMapping
request_fields.description: Determine the Products Mapped on the Merchant, Multiple Products can be mapped on the Merchant by Inputting Product IDs comma Seperated Check the Product IDs provided by CoreCARD Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXX, XXXXX Example: 12345, 5432 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: HoldAccountStatus1
request_fields.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also Add Unmailed to Reserve Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses

request_fields.name: HoldAccountStatus2
request_fields.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also Add Unmailed to Reserve Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses

request_fields.name: HoldAccountStatus3
request_fields.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also Add Unmailed to Reserve Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses

request_fields.name: HoldAccountStatus4
request_fields.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also Add Unmailed to Reserve Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses

request_fields.name: HoldCreditBalances
request_fields.description: If Set to Yes then if All account available under the Merchant with Negative Current Balance will be Eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured for the Account only if the status of the Account is not in one of the HoldAccountStatus fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in IncludedStatus fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0 Condition: If kept Blank Default Value will be considered as '0' = Yes

request_fields.name: DebitBalancesUnder
request_fields.description: If any Account has Current Balance Greater than 0 and Lower than the Amount set this field/tag, then it will be Eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if HoldCreditBalances is set to No and if the status of the Account is not in one of the HoldAccountStatus fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in IncludedStatus fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

request_fields.name: FromAccountNumber
request_fields.description: If any Account Number falls between from This Account Number to Account Number set in ToAccountNumber, it will be eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if HoldCreditBalances is set to 'No' and if the status of the Account is not in one of the 'HoldAccountStatus' fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in 'IncludedStatus' fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 9000000111111222222333 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ToAccountNumber
request_fields.description: If any Account Number falls between the  Account Number in FromAccountNUmber to Account Number set in ToAccountNumber, it will be eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if HoldCreditBalances is set to No and if the status of the Account is not in one of the HoldAccountStatus fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in IncludedStatus fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 90000001111112222 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumberGenerationFlag
request_fields.description: If Set To Yes then Account Number will be Auto Generated for the Accounts Created Under this Merchant Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0

request_fields.name: AccountNumberBegin
request_fields.description: For internally-generated account numbers, this is the first account number that can be issued for this Merchant. This number is added to the number in the Increment By field to generate the first account number. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Condition:Required only if AccountNumberGenerationflag is Set to Yes Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumberEnd
request_fields.description: For internally-generated card numbers, this is the last account number that can be issued for this Merchant Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Condition:Required only if AccountNumberGenerationflag is Set to Yes Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumberIncrementBy
request_fields.description: The Begin Number is added to this number to generate the first account number. Subsequent account numbers are generated by adding the Last Used Account Number to this number. Condition:Required only if AccountNumberGenerationflag is Set to Yes

request_fields.name: AccountNumberLastUsed
request_fields.description: The last generated account number displays in this field/Tag, which is used to generate the next account number by adding the value in the Increment By field to this number. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Condition:Required only if AccountNumberGenerationflag is Set to Yes Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumberCheckDigitRoutine
request_fields.description: Determines the Modulous formula applied for Check Digit Routine Valid Values: '0'= Mod10, '1' = Mod11 and '2' = None Format: X Example: 2 Condition:Required only if AccountNumberGenerationflag is Set to Yes

request_fields.name: IsForwardedToUCA
request_fields.description: Field : MerchantPLAccounts.IsForwardedToUCA LookUp: CCardLookup; LutId = 'IsForwardedToUCA '

request_fields.name: TransactionDescriptionMandatory
request_fields.description: Field : MerchantPLAccounts.TransactionDescriptionMandatory

request_fields.name: AccountActivationEnabled
request_fields.description: Field : MerchantPLAccounts.AccountActivationEnabled

request_fields.name: ExcludeFlashScreen
request_fields.description: Field : MerchantPLAccounts.ExcludeFlashScreen

request_fields.name: SuppressPrequalReminderMails
request_fields.description: Field : MerchantPLAccounts.SuppressPrequalReminderMails LookUp: CCardLookup; LutId = 'SuppressPrequalReminderMails '

request_fields.name: MerchantLogo
request_fields.description: File Name for the Logo File Valid Values:0-1 A-Z Format:XXXX Example:LogoFile1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: TimeToContactFrom
request_fields.description: Contact Number of the Distribution Partner Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXX Example:8:30 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: TimeToContactTo
request_fields.description: Contact Number of the Distribution Partner Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXX Example:6 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: SiteURL
request_fields.description: URL of the site Valid Values:0-1 A-Z Format:XXXX Example:mysite.com/card Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Motto
request_fields.description: Motto Valid Values:0-1 A-Z Format:XXXX Example:Be Independent Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: CardActivationURL
request_fields.description: Motto Valid Values:0-1 A-Z Format:XXXX Example:Be Independent Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: Disclosure
request_fields.description: Motto Valid Values:0-1 A-Z Format:XXXX Example:Be Independent Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: ContactNumber
request_fields.description: Contact Number of the Distribution Partner Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXX Example:02245879654 Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: WeekDayHours
request_fields.description: Contact Number of the Distribution Partner Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXX Example:8:30 Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: WeekendHours
request_fields.description: Contact Number of the Distribution Partner Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXX Example:6 Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CardDescription
request_fields.description: This field will be used to provide the description of the card Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: DaystoDisplaySplashPage
request_fields.description: DaystoDisplaySplashPage Valid Values:0-1 Format:XX Example:30 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CompanyID
request_fields.description: Will determine Unique ID of Company Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CompanyName
request_fields.description: Company Name Valid Values:A-Z Example: abc Allowable Values: 16

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
